notes: Independently read all 131 production JS/TS files (27,366 source lines), including browser code, declarations, local barrels, CLI, doctor/database-port APIs and the SQLite worker, plus package.json and openclaw.plugin.json. Findings were manually identified; scripts only format transcribed expectations, copy evidence locations, enumerate files and calculate hashes/counts.

Package metadata declares index.ts, browser/index.ts and src/sqlite-store.worker.ts as shipped entrypoints. Production relative imports stay within the plugin root. @openclaw/workboard-contract, @openclaw/gateway-protocol and other separately installed workspace/package dependencies are ownership boundaries and are not recursively audited.

Test-directory imports and the five colocated test-support helpers were checked against callers; none are imported by production. Browser translation JSON/JSONL, styles/assets, SQL and tsconfig.json are non-source exclusions under the frozen source-extension rule.

api.ts reexports definePluginEntry, OpenClawPluginApi and OpenClawPluginService. Local imports retain those original SDK-export identities and syntax kinds without adding synthetic SDK-module sites. WorkboardSqlConnection is a direct type alias of EngineConnection; custom SQL and store result members are not public runtime members.

Browser ControlUiHost, ControlUiComponents and their related imported types are SDK-export dependencies. Their host.request, host.sessions, host.navigation and host.components members are browser contracts, not OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime paths. Browser WorkboardRuntime/WorkboardWidgetRuntime and backend WorkboardStoreRuntime are plugin-owned structures.

Server runtime provenance is established by OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime contracts and unchanged handle/callable propagation. Literal Pick and indexed type references select the maximal public members. The sandbox authority callables remain direct aliases through workspace-access.ts; plugin-owned forwarding wrappers are not treated as SDK symbols.

Service contexts (logger/getCron/gatewayEvents), command/tool contexts, doctor migration contexts, worktree/config/database results and other SDK helper return objects do not become API/runtime handles. No calls are inferred from SDK helper implementation bodies.

Manifest contracts cover cliCommands.name, commandAliases.name and all 38 contracts.tools declarations. backupResources, uiCapabilities, categories, doctorContract, activation, dashboard, catalog, toolMetadata, configSchema and controlUi are metadata outside the specified manifest identity fields.

ReferenceKinds include every established syntax/use category with representative evidence per kind. reviewedFiles.findingCount counts distinct findings evidenced in that file; zero does not mean the file was skipped.

Original-owner canonicalization correction: the frozen contract names cliCommands.name and commandAliases.name as manifest fields. The object name declarations at openclaw.plugin.json:21 and :126 therefore use manifest.cliCommands.name:workboard and manifest.commandAliases.name:workboard. Only these two identities/keys are corrected; their evidence, classifications, reference kinds and all counts are unchanged.

Original-owner source-only reconciliation: MAX_DATE_TIMESTAMP_MS can pass unchanged through the explicit fallback in store-constants.ts:82, the expiresAt binding and metadata.claim.expiresAt container in store-workflow.ts:95-98/163, the patch alias and metadata argument in store-core.ts:530/573, and the guarded local objects in store-normalizers.ts:846/916. The read record.expiresAt at store-normalizers.ts:679 therefore contributes member-access to the imported constant under the existing unchanged-local-container rule. This does not infer SDK helper return values or add a call kind. The original auditor reread the pinned source without candidate implementation/output and confirmed import plus member-access; identities, classifications, coverage and unknowns are unchanged.
